summary: Move-learning decoder exposed stale current text while the active printer showed the live page
symptom: During Snarl/Bulldoze acknowledgement, text.current retained a partial or older page while an active field printer and screenshot showed the current selector or learned page. Generic current-text gating would have pressed at the wrong boundary.
root_cause: The decoder preserves multiple text printers for forensics, but text.current is not guaranteed to identify the active field printer after a page transition.
fix: Gate move-learning A presses on page text belonging to active window-5/6 printers; use the current text only as a fallback. Treat the mode-33 forget question as a separate acknowledgement before directional selection, and use B-only cleanup after the party move tuple changes.

regression.synthetic_active_page_check: stale Use-on-current text did not override active learned page
